purpose: Additive retention snapshot for baseline deployment and the unpromoted ten-epoch experiment; not a cleanup plan or deletion authorization

historicalIndex.relationship: Complements this unchanged 2026-09-06 historical index; does not supersede it. Future cleanup must preserve the union of both indexes, including the separately retained single-cell classifier.

unpromotedTrainingCandidate.reason: Training selected epoch10, but identical-decoder external exact accuracy decreased from 323/607 to 306/607; promotion was vetoed and baseline retained.

retentionRules: Do not remove the old baseline, single-cell checkpoint, unpromoted epoch10 checkpoint, or any retained epoch merely because it is not used by the APK.
Preserve every listed source/configuration/evidence file and each external experiment directory; their ancestor directories must not be recursively deleted or moved during cleanup.
This is a dated snapshot. Later changes require an additional retention record rather than rewriting this historical index.
Full external dataset/environment trees are preserved by directory path; this index records their locations and provenance, not a hash of every installed package or dataset pixel.
